question: Does delta-neutral funding carry earn more when it rotates each week into the large-cap coins currently paying the most funding, after fees and basis risk?

universe.rule: 20 large caps with both a Binance USDT spot pair and a USDT perpetual, chosen by size before any funding or return is looked at; a coin is eligible on a day only if both legs and funding have data

selection: the 5 eligible coins with the highest mean daily funding over the 7 days ending at the rebalance; only coins whose mean is above 0; fewer than 5 if fewer qualify; equal notional; the rest of the book idle in cash
construction: per coin, carry.hedge_daily daily P&L (spot return - perp return + funding received); a coin's daily P&L counts only while it is held; legs reset to equal notional at each weekly rebalance

costs.rule: every coin that enters or leaves the book pays the pair cost (both legs) on its notional share

capital: return on notional and on capital with a 50/50 spot/margin split (daily return / 2), as in carry-study-v1
benchmark: carry-study-v1 always-on BTC/ETH over the same window
pass_rule: none: descriptive. Any real-money use would first need a forward record, like carry-forward-v1.
